title: Welcome to the blog
post: This is a **sample post**. Every `.json` file in the `blog/` folder becomes a post on the blog page.
- The file name becomes the URL, so `welcome.json` lives at `#/blog/welcome`.
- `post` is written in markdown. Use an array of lines (like this one) or one string with `\n` for line breaks.
- `categories` is a list, so a post can belong to several categories.
Delete or edit this file whenever you like.
